reason: In src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:53,105, worker processes are created via multiprocessing.get_context("spawn").Process (returning SpawnProcess, a sibling of multiprocessing.context.Process under BaseProcess), so isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) at src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:254 is always False. As a result, process.kill() at line 255 is never executed before _create_process_for_shards() starts a replacement at line 259, whereas the pre-PR code called self.process.kill() unconditionally.
